title: Make talking to users a weekly habit
summary: The best product teams talk to users every week, not just at the start of a project. Small, regular contact keeps decisions grounded in reality.

beginner: Book one user conversation a week.
intermediate: Automate recruiting so you have a conversation booked every week.
Interview as a trio: PM, designer and engineer.
Ask about specific recent stories, not opinions.
Add what you learn to your opportunity map.
experienced: Make weekly discovery a team norm.
Connect discovery to outcomes and the opportunity tree.
Coach other teams to build the habit.

canDelegateTo.task: Set up recruiting and coach interviewing

toolExamples.notion: Keep an interview snapshot per conversation.
toolExamples.miro: Update your opportunity map after each interview.
toolExamples.claude: Paste anonymised notes and ask for opportunities and quotes. Check against the notes.

definitionOfDone: A user conversation booked every week
pitfalls: Asking people what features they want
Only the PM talks to users
